overlays.sub: Software as a service · for manufacturers

overlays.text: Smart-Clearance
One platform for manufacturers, built around an **ecosystem of AI agents**.
Set up for its supply chain: its **distributors and super stockists**, its gates, its exits, its rules.
The brand's distributors and their godowns
**Ten agents**, working together along **nine stops**, on Gemini.
Detect, verify, value, decide, execute, settle, report. Then the **one yes**.
Nothing moves before a person's **yes**. The staff console watches every client's batches and agents at work.
The agents at work, stop by stop
The manufacturer, the distributor, the super stockist, the kirana, the buyer, the staff, the food bank: **each on their own screen, acting in their own name**.
Partners act through their own accounts; **nobody stands in for anyone**.
